item.title: Joined SUTD as a Research Fellow
item.description: I have joined the Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD) as a Research Fellow, working with Prof. CHEE Yeow Meng.

item.title: Paper accepted at SIGMOD 2026
item.description:
Our paper On Self-Designing Learned Indexes has been accepted and will appear in Proceedings of the ACM on Management of Data, 4(3) (SIGMOD 2026).

Joint work with Guoyu Hu, Bing Li, Xiaokui Xiao, Zhanhao Zhao and Beng Chin Ooi.

item.title: Paper to appear at ICCAD 2026
item.description: Multimodal Prior-Guided Zero-Shot Design Constraint Tuning Under Domain Shifts has been accepted at the IEEE/ACM International Conference on Computer-Aided Design (ICCAD), San Jose, Nov. 8-12, 2026.
